stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2024 first-year class; residency by known physical address): 462 of 491 international applicants were admitted (94%) versus 81% overall; 31 international students enrolled. The average high school GPA of 3.11 uses the Common Data Set conversion (HS average x 0.08 - 4.0 from a 100-point scale); the GPA band table could not be read from the PDF text. 23% (291 students) sent SAT scores; the Common Data Set shows no ACT submitters (IPEDS: 3%, 34 students). IPEDS fall 2024 ranges: SAT EBRW 530-630, Math 540-640, ACT composite 23-29. No early decision/early action. Undergraduate enrollment (5,517) is from College Navigator, fall 2024; it lists 3% nonresident (no headcount).

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (first-year, 2024-25): nonresident tuition $17,320, required fees $1,755, food and housing on campus $17,026. These are 2024-25 figures; 2026-27 rates were not confirmed
